offering_description.value: Rents natural gas compression equipment and sells newly fabricated compressor packages and parts to oil and gas producers and midstream operators. Units are fabricated and serviced at company facilities and deployed from its rental fleet across US producing regions.

primary_products.value: natural gas compressor packages; compressor parts

primary_services.value: compressor rental; maintenance and aftermarket service

customer_segment.value: B2B: oil and gas producers, midstream gas gathering and processing operators

end_markets.value: oil and gas production; midstream natural gas gathering and processing

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: compressor units rented to customers over contract periods; product sales: newly fabricated compressor packages and replacement parts; service fees: maintenance and aftermarket service for compressor fleets
revenue_model.category: rental or leasing; product sales; service fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and operates a rental compressor fleet, takes in equipment and sells rental use to producers; OEM / manufacturer: fabricates compressor packages from purchased components, sold to producers and midstream operators; service provider: takes in service work on compressor fleets, sold to fleet owners and operators
value_chain_position.category: asset operator; OEM / manufacturer; service provider

geography_served.value: US national: major US oil and gas producing basins, including the Permian and Appalachian regions

specialization.value: related lines: compressor rental, new compressor fabrication, aftermarket parts and service

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales and rental contracts with producers and midstream operators; own locations: company service and fabrication facilities in US oil and gas regions

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: air emissions and workplace safety rules from EPA and state environmental and safety agencies
